# Contributions

This project is maintained by FuryziN. Public visibility does not grant write access to the repository. The maintainer decides which changes are accepted.

Open an issue to discuss a change before submitting it. Do not include private projects, Factorio data dumps, saves, installation folders, credentials, or personal file paths in issues or pull requests.

External contributions must be reviewed and authorized by the maintainer. No automation in this repository merges pull requests or grants access.

No open-source license has been selected for this project. Do not assume that publishing the source grants a separate redistribution or derivative-work license. Factorio and its artwork belong to Wube Software.
